cyber_airdrop_system.materialization_mechanic: Starts transparent (bullets pass through). Materializes as captured to act as solid cover.
cyber_airdrop_system.capture_contest_rule: Enemies in capture zone trigger a contest. Must knock down enemies to claim ownership.
